name: Tanaka Gandamu
source: As the Ultimate Breeder, there's no animal that Gundam cannot tame. He not only managed to successfully proliferate an endangered species, but it's speculated that he's even capable of holding conversations with animals. His pet hamsters - or The Four Dark Gods of Destruction, as he calls them - can often be seen peeking their eads out from under his scarf, and Gundam sincerely believes that he and his Four Dark Gods of Destruction will one day rule the world.
